```{r}
inf <- project_info
cases <- inf %>% filter(Condition == "HFD+L1") %>% pull(BC)
controls<-inf %>% filter(Condition == "HFD") %>% pull(BC)
```

```{r}

function(x){ sum(x[cases]) >= 3 |
sum(x[controls] >= 3 )} )
expressed_genes<- rownames(ex_counts)[cnt_select]
```


```{r}
inf <- data.frame(inf)# (DESeq does not like tibbles)
# make sure that the ids in the info table have
# the same order as the columns in the count table
rownames(inf)<-inf$BC
inf<-inf[colnames(cnt.filt),]
colnames(cnt.filt)==rownames(inf)
```

```{r}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cnt.filt, colData = inf, design = ~ Condition)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
summary(sizeFactors(dds))
dds<-estimateDispersions(dds)
glimpse(colData(dds))
plotDispEsts(dds)

saveRDS(dds,file="dds.rds")

```

```{r}
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation( dds )
# extract a matrix of normalized counts from the S4 object vsd
vsdMat <- assay(vsd)
```

```{r}
library(vsn)
vsn::meanSdPlot(vsdMat)
#Note this creates only the right-most plot
```

```{r}
library("variancePartition")
form <- ~ Condition
varPart <- fitExtractVarPartModel(vsdMat, form, inf)
vp <- sortCols(varPart) #ordering the properties according to effect size
plotVarPart(vp)+coord_flip()
# Look at the 10 genes for which most of the variance could be explained by sample properties
vp <- vp[order(vp$Residuals), ]
plotPercentBars(vp[1:10, ])
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
dds <- dds2
# Extract normalized counts from the DESeq2 object
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)

# Filter for genes of interest
genes_of_interest <- grep("^Ccl|^Cxcl|^Mif|^Stat|^Il|^Timp|^Ifn", rownames(normalized_counts), value = TRUE)
filtered_counts <- normalized_counts[genes_of_interest, ]

# Convert to a data frame for easier manipulation
df <- as.data.frame(t(filtered_counts))
df$Condition <- colData(dds)$Condition  # Add condition information

# Reshape the data for ggplot2
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Condition, names_to = "gene", values_to = "count")

# Generate the boxplot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = gene, y = count, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Normalized Counts of Genes Starting with 'Ccl', 'Cxcl', and 'Mif'",
       x = "Gene",
       y = "Normalized Count")

# Perform t-tests for each gene
# Perform t-tests for each gene
t_test_results <- df_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(p_value = t.test(count ~ Condition)$p.value) #%>%
  #filter(p_value < 0.05)  # Filter for p-values less than 0.05

# Apply BH correction to the p-values
t_test_results <- t_test_results %>%
  mutate(adjusted_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) #%>%
  #filter(adjusted_p_value < 0.05)  # Filter for adjusted p-values less than 0.05

print(t_test_results)

# Generate the boxplot only for significant genes
significant_genes <- t_test_results$gene
df_long_significant <- df_long %>%
  filter(gene %in% significant_genes)

ggplot(df_long_significant, aes(x = gene, y = count, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Normalized Counts of Significant Genes (p < 0.05)",
       x = "Gene",
       y = "Normalized Count")

```
